title: Expired optimistic transaction can resurrect a row deleted before GC
module: TiDB GC reporter + client-go transaction commit + TiKV compaction

payload.p_check: transactions older than tidb_gc_max_wait_time stop protecting min-start-TS and GC may reclaim their conflict evidence
payload.q_claim: every consumer of the retired startTS is fail-closed before creating effects
payload.failure: KVTxn.Commit reaches prewrite without CheckVisibility while reads contain the guard
payload.terminal_effect: COMMIT success permanently recreated a row deleted and collected after the transaction snapshot

name: GC-retired startTS cannot reach effectful commit
module: TiDB GC reporter + client-go transaction commit + TiKV compaction

payload.p_check: an active startTS older than the configurable report horizon is no longer preserved by GC
payload.q_claim: every later consumer of that startTS is rejected before it creates a durable effect
payload.failure: commit lacks visibility admission before prewrite
payload.highest_consumer: durable row state observed by a fresh SQL session

algorithm: identify the event that stops preserving evidence for an owner, timestamp, snapshot, generation, or lease
enumerate every read and effectful consumer that can still act as that owner
subtract fail-closed guards owned by the retirement contract
classify remaining guards as mandatory, new-install default, upgrade fallback, session configurable, or best effort
reclaim the exact evidence retirement permits
invoke the highest durable consumer and compare terminal result with fresh state
change only the missing owner admission, then audit TOCTOU
negative_screens: consumer is impossible after retirement by construction
storage atomically checks the retirement frontier with the effect
guard is mandatory across bootstrap, upgrade, and runtime configuration
reclaimed evidence is not needed to reject the stale effect

observations: safe point greater than stale startTS

name: Stalled optimistic order update crosses GC retirement

payload.production_shape: an order reconciliation or settlement worker buffers an optimistic UPDATE, holds the SQL transaction during an external API call or paused batch, while a cleanup worker deletes the same order
settings: tidb_txn_assertion_level=OFF observable on compatibility or explicitly configured Classic clusters
tidb_gc_max_wait_time=600 to keep abandoned transactions from blocking GC
payload.timeline: after roughly 20-30 minutes the old startTS is excluded, the next GC safe point can pass it, and routine compaction on a write-active table removes the delete and old value; the worker resumes before client-go's 24h maximum
payload.terminal: old COMMIT succeeds and the deleted order row reappears
payload.test_compression: direct safe-point advancement and production compaction request replace only wall-clock/phase waiting
